title: Ikamba ryahanganye n'ikirere
intro: Mu nzira z'ubwami bwa kera, izina ry'umutegetsi umwe ryabaye inyito y'igitugu n'ubwibone. Ubwo umugaragu woroheje wa Allah yazaga afite ibimenyetso bidashidikanywaho, uwo mutegetsi ukomeye yanze kwemera ukuri. Uyu munsi, inshingano yawe ni ukumenya uyu muntu w'inkuru z'impimbano washenye ubwami bwe kandi amaherezo ye akaba yarafunzwe n'imiraba.
clues: Ndi umutegetsi utinya cyane, izina rye riracyari umuburo mu bihe byose.
Nategetse abantu bose gukora imirimo y'uburetwa, bashyiraho inzibutso zamamaza ikuzo ryanjye.
Ubwo intumwa ya Allah yazaga imbere yanjye izanye ibimenyetso bidashidikanywaho, nanze kunama maze mbyita ubupfumu.
Nategetse kwica abana b'abahungu b'impinja mu bwoko bw'imbohe, niringiye kubakomeretsa imitima mbere yuko babyuka.
Nahagaze imbere y'urukiko rwanjye maze ndavuga nti 'Ndi umwami wanyu uruta abandi bose,' nsaba gusengwa nk'imana.
Ndi kumwe na Minisitiri w’Intebe wanjye iruhande rwanjye, nubatse inyubako ndende igamije kuzamuka ikarenga ikirere.
